OperationsSheets.SampleNotice: Sample data. This page will show the record's own data once Operations' services are built.

MissionOrder.Title: Mission order
MissionOrder.Description: Printed for the team, filled in on site, then brought back to be typed in.
MissionOrder.PrintNotRecorded: The print could not be recorded.

InspectionSheet.Title: Supervisor inspection sheet
InspectionSheet.Description: Marked on site by the supervisor; the office works out the score out of 100.

DaySheet.Title: Supervisor day sheet
DaySheet.Description: The day's visits, absences and quality follow-up for one supervisor.

CallList.Title: Client call list
CallList.Description: The clients to telephone about tomorrow's visits. Nothing is sent by the program.

WorkRules.OVERLAP: Two visits at the same time, or too close to travel between
WorkRules.DAY_SPAN_12H: The working day spans too many hours
WorkRules.WEEK_OVER_48H: Above the weekly limit, overtime included
WorkRules.NO_REST_DAY: No rest day in the week
WorkRules.UNAVAILABLE_DAY: A day the worker is not available
WorkRules.ON_LEAVE: A day of recorded absence or leave
WorkRules.WEEK_OVER_CAPACITY: Above the worker's own weekly hours
WorkRules.DAY_OVER_8H: Above a day's hours of work
WorkRules.REST_DAY_WORKED: Work on the weekly rest day

ReplacementExclusions.OVERLAP: On another visit at that time
ReplacementExclusions.WOMEN_ONLY: The site asks for women only
ReplacementExclusions.MISSING_ABILITY: Lacks an ability the site needs
ReplacementExclusions.DAY_SPAN_12H: The day would span too many hours
ReplacementExclusions.WEEK_OVER_48H: The week would pass the limit

ProgrammeWarnings.END_BEFORE_START: The end date is before the start date
ProgrammeWarnings.VISITS_PER_WEEK_MISMATCH: The days ticked do not match the number of visits a week
ProgrammeWarnings.REST_DAY_SLOT: A visit falls on the weekly rest day
ProgrammeWarnings.OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_WINDOW: A visit falls outside the hours the client allows
ProgrammeWarnings.DURATION_DAYS_MISMATCH: The length in days does not match the dates
ProgrammeWarnings.NO_WORKING_DAY_IN_RANGE: No working day between the two dates
ProgrammeWarnings.MISSING_DATES: The form gives no start or end date
ProgrammeWarnings.OUTSIDE_SITE_DAYS: A visit falls on a day the site does not allow
ProgrammeWarnings.OUTSIDE_SITE_HOURS: A visit falls outside the hours the site allows

VisitEntry.Title: Visit {number}
VisitEntry.Description: Type in the mission order returned from the site, as it is written on the sheet.

Cards.OrderHint: As printed on the order. Nothing here is changed by typing the sheet.
Cards.AttendanceHint: Type the times as written on the sheet, and tick where the site contact initialled.
Cards.ChecklistHint: Tick what the worker ticked on the sheet.
Cards.SignoffHint: The slip as the client filled it in.
Cards.CorrectionHint: A time typed before was changed. Say why: the log keeps the old time and your reason.

VisitEntry.ProblemOnSite: Was there a problem on site?
VisitEntry.IncompleteReason: Why the work was not completed
VisitEntry.SignerName: Name of the person who signed
VisitEntry.WantsOtherService: Does the client ask for another service?
VisitEntry.WouldRecommend: Would the client recommend the centre?
VisitEntry.SignedOnPaper: The client or the site contact signed the slip

EntryState.PARTIAL: Partly typed in: {count, plural, one {# item missing} other {# items missing}}

Missing.INCOMPLETE_REASON: Why the work was not completed
Missing.SIGNOFF: The client's sign-off, or why nobody signed

Notes.LATE: {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} after the planned start
Notes.LATE_NO_REASON: Late beyond the grace time: type the reason if the sheet gives one
Notes.ARRIVAL_NOT_INITIALLED: The arrival time is not initialled by the site contact
Notes.DEPARTURE_NOT_INITIALLED: The departure time is not initialled by the site contact
Notes.OVERLAP: Overlaps another visit of the same worker
Notes.DAY_SPAN_12H: The working day spans {duration} hours, more than 12
Notes.UNAVAILABLE_DAY: A day the worker's form does not offer
Notes.ON_LEAVE: A day of recorded absence or leave
Notes.WEEK_OVER_CAPACITY: {duration} hours this week, more than the worker's own hours
Notes.DAY_OVER_8H: {duration} hours of work that day, more than 8
Notes.REST_DAY_WORKED: Work on the weekly rest day
Notes.FULL_WITH_UNTICKED: Marked fully completed, yet {count, plural, one {# task is} other {# tasks are}} not ticked
Notes.PERCENT_DISAGREES: The percentage does not match the state of the work
Notes.BECOMES_DONE: On saving, the visit is marked done
Notes.BECOMES_PROBLEM: On saving, the visit is marked as a problem
Notes.OPENS_COMPLAINT: On saving, a quality complaint is opened from the client's notes
Notes.PROPOSES_EXTRA_VISIT: On saving, an extra visit is proposed
Notes.LEAD_FOR_CLIENTS: On saving, the request goes to Clients as a lead

VisitEntry.SaveFailed: The returned order could not be saved.
VisitEntry.SavedComplete: The returned order is saved and the visit is signed off.
VisitEntry.SavedPartial: Saved. The entry is not complete yet.
VisitEntry.NoWorkers: No worker is assigned to this visit yet.

DayBoard.OpenSeats: {count, plural, one {# seat to fill} other {# seats to fill}}
DayBoard.ArrivedVia: The team's arrival, phoned in by
DayBoard.SaveFailed: The arrival could not be logged.

Errors.AbsentWorkerTimes: A worker marked absent cannot have times.
Errors.TimesOutOfOrder: The times must follow each other: arrival, start of work, end of work, departure.
Errors.ProblemKindsWithoutProblem: Problem kinds are ticked, but the sheet says there was no problem.
Errors.SignoffOrNobody: Give either the client's answer or why nobody signed, not both.
Errors.ClientFileNotFound: This client file does not exist.
Errors.VisitsForContractedFileOnly: Visits are made for a contracted file only.
Errors.ReturnedOrderInvalid: This returned order cannot be saved as it is typed.
Errors.ReturnedOrderVisitClosed: A cancelled or postponed visit takes no returned order.
Errors.WorkerNotOnVisit: This worker is not on the visit.
Errors.WorkerRecordedAbsent: This worker is recorded absent that day. Cancel the absence first.
Errors.CorrectionNeedsReason: Say why a time already typed is changed.
Errors.VisitNotWaiting: This visit is not waiting for its team.
Errors.LeaveNeedsTypeAndDays: A leave needs its type and its number of days.
Errors.ConfirmNeedsFullTeam: A visit is confirmed only when every seat is filled.
Errors.VisitTeamFull: Every seat of this visit is already filled.
Errors.AbsenceNeedsBothTimes: Give both the start and the end time of the absence.
Errors.NightWorkNeedsDerogation: Night work by a woman needs the reference of the labour inspector's derogation.
Errors.OnlyRequestedLeaveDecided: Only a leave that was asked for can be approved or refused.
Errors.OnlyAssignedSeatRemoved: Only an assigned worker can be taken off a visit.
Errors.SeatNotReplaceable: Only a seat held or left by an absence can be replaced.
Errors.OnlyAwaitingVisitConfirmed: Only a visit awaiting confirmation can be confirmed.
Errors.AbsenceEndsBeforeStart: The absence cannot end before it starts.
Errors.EndTimeAfterStartTime: The end time must be after the start time.
Errors.DaysZeroOrMore: The number of days must be zero or more.
Errors.VisitTeamClosed: The team of this visit can no longer change.
Errors.AbsenceAlreadyClosed: This absence is already cancelled or refused.
Errors.SeatNeedsManager: This seat breaks a working-time rule. Only the manager can allow it.
Errors.SiteWomenOnly: This site takes women workers only.
Errors.WorkerHasOverlappingVisit: This worker already has a visit at that time.
Errors.WorkerNotSchedulable: This worker cannot be given visits.
Errors.WorkerLacksSiteAbility: This worker does not have an ability this site requires.
Errors.WorkerAlreadyOnVisit: This worker is already on this visit.
Errors.WorkerSanctioned: This worker is suspended or penalised.

FileVisits.ProgrammeHint: What the form's execution days and dates call for. Visits that exist are never changed here.
FileVisits.GenerateFailed: The visits could not be made.
FileVisits.NoVisits: This file has no visit yet.
